data.name: Babarah
data.gender_notes: Babarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic words ‘Bab’ meaning gate and ‘Rah’ meaning mercy or compassion. The name Babarah signifies a gentle, exalted one who is full of mercy and compassion. The name Babarah carries the meaning “Gentle, Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Babarah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's endless mercy and compassion towards His creation.
data.etymology: Babarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Babarah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
